name: reference
description: Runnable examples for each public suite feature.

scenarios.name: uses suite defaults
scenarios.description: The scenario inherits its host, profile, skills, and workspace.

scenarios.name: shows a host and profile override
scenarios.description: This skipped example shows a scenario-level host and profile override.

scenarios.name: uses context
scenarios.description: The runner adds one context file to the agent input.
scenarios.prompt: Reply with the support code from the added context. Do not use tools.

scenarios.name: uses a seed patch
scenarios.description: The runner applies a patch before the agent starts.
scenarios.prompt: Read seeded.txt. Reply with its exact value.

scenarios.name: uses text command tool and skill rules
scenarios.description: This scenario shows the deterministic rubric fields together.
scenarios.prompt: Read PROJECT.md. Use the release-note skill. Call echo with RULE_TOOL_OK. Run node -e "console.log('RULE_COMMAND_OK')". Reply with the release note, RULE_TOOL_OK, and RULE_COMMAND_OK. Do not read records/TASK-101.md.

scenarios.name: uses ordered tool rules
scenarios.description: The required MCP calls can have extra calls between them.
scenarios.prompt: Call search_tasks for TASK-104. Then call echo with EXTRA_OK. Then call get_task with TASK-104. Reply with the current due date in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

scenarios.name: shows routing fields
scenarios.description: The report scores the routing block, tier, and review depth.
scenarios.prompt: Reply with a Routing section that names tier low. Then write: Review · staged · Quick · task-list and Depth: Quick. Do not use tools.

scenarios.name: uses a sidecar rubric
scenarios.description: The scenario keeps its rubric in rubrics.json.

scenarios.name: shows hands-on routing
scenarios.description: The agent gives one routing line before it acts.
scenarios.prompt: Start with this exact line: Routing: Low — one direct reply. Then write HANDS_ON_OK. Do not use tools.

scenarios.name: compares two arms with absolute and pair gates
scenarios.description: Both arms must pass, and the direct tool arm must use fewer tools.
scenarios.prompt: Find the current due date for TASK-104. Reply with the date only.

a.label: files
a.prompt: Read records/TASK-101.md, records/TASK-102.md, records/TASK-103.md, and records/TASK-104.md separately. Do not use a wildcard. Reply with the current due date for TASK-104 in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

b.label: index
b.prompt: Call task_index for TASK-104. Reply with the current due date in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

judgeMetrics.question: Does the answer use the current task record?

scenarios.name: compares three named arms
scenarios.description: Three arms report outcome, judge, turns, tokens, tools, and duration without gates.
scenarios.prompt: Reply with the current due date for TASK-104.

arms.description: Reads the current local task record.
arms.prompt: Read records/TASK-104.md. Reply with the due date in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

arms.description: Calls the current task detail tool.
arms.prompt: Call get_task with TASK-104. Reply with the due date in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

arms.description: Calls the current task index tool.
arms.prompt: Call task_index for TASK-104. Reply with the due date in YYYY-MM-DD format only.

judgeMetrics.question: Does the answer give the date without unrelated detail?
